description_en: Queries a smart tagging or video fingerprinting job. After you submit a smart tagging or video fingerprinting job, ApsaraVideo VOD asynchronously processes the job. You can call this operation to query the job information in real time
description_zh: 调用本接口查询智能标签或视频DNA作业。在提交智能标签或视频DNA作业后，会进行异步处理，通过此接口可以实时查询作业信息
name: ListAIJob

parameters.description_en:
The list of job IDs. You can obtain the job ID from the PlayInfo parameter in the response to the [GetPlayInfo](~~56124~~) operation.

>  You can specify a maximum of 10 job IDs in a request. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
parameters.description_zh:
作业ID列表。JobId可以通过[GetPlayInfo](~~56124~~)接口中返回的PlayInfo结构体中获取。

> 多个ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多可以查询10个作业ID。
parameters.help_en:
